/* selectCode - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_ID, X.CMMNS_CD_ID_ORI, X.UP_CMMNS_CD_ID, X.CMMNS_CD_NM, X.CMMNS_CD_DSCRP_CN, X.CMMNS_CD_CN, X.CMMNS_CD_USE_SCRIN_CN, X.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM1, X.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM2, X.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM3, X.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM4, X.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM5, X.CMMNS_CD_LEVELA_NO, X.UNT_SYS_SE_CD
FROM ( SELECT C.CMMNS_CD_ID, C.CMMNS_CD_ID AS CMMNS_CD_ID_ORI, C.UP_CMMNS_CD_ID, C.CMMNS_CD_NM, C.CMMNS_CD_DSCRP_CN, C.CMMNS_CD_CN, C.CMMNS_CD_USE_SCRIN_CN, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM1, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM2, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM3, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM4, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE_NM5, C.CMMNS_CD_LEVELA_NO, ( SELECT ',' || LISTAGG(D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CMMNS_CD_ID) || ',' FROM SAC200 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = C.CMMNS_CD_ID ) AS UNT_SYS_SE_CD
FROM SAC000 C
START WITH C.UP_CMMNS_CD_ID = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR C.CMMNS_CD_ID = C.UP_CMMNS_CD_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY C.FRST_REG_DT, C.CMMNS_CD_ID ) X
AND X.CMMNS_CD_ID LIKE '%' || #{cmmnsCdId} || '%'
AND X.CMMNS_CD_NM LIKE '%' || #{cmmnsCdNm} || '%'
AND X.UNT_SYS_SE_CD LIKE '%,' || #{unitSystem} || ',%'

SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID, CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5, LACA_ADDTNG_MNG_CN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT

/* selectCommonCode - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID, CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5, LACA_ADDTNG_MNG_CN, SRTNG_SQNCE, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM (
SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID, CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5, LACA_ADDTNG_MNG_CN, SRTNG_SQNCE, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAC100 C /* 공통코드 값 */
WHERE C.CMMNS_CD_ID = #{codeId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAC110 D /* 공통코드값 사용시스템 */ WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = C.CMMNS_CD_ID AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{unitCode} )
AND C.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID, CMMNS_CD_VALUE, CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5, LACA_ADDTNG_MNG_CN, SRTNG_SQNCE, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAC100 C /* 공통코드 값 */
WHERE C.CMMNS_CD_ID = #{codeId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD FROM SAC110 D /* 공통코드값 사용시스템 */ WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = C.CMMNS_CD_ID AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE )
AND C.USE_YN = 'Y'
) X
ORDER BY X.SRTNG_SQNCE

/* selectCommonCodeAllUnit - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID, CMMNS_CD_VALUE, ( CASE WHEN C.USE_YN = 'N' then '[삭제]' WHEN (NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SAC110 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = C.CMMNS_CD_ID AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE),0)) = 0 THEN '' WHEN (NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SAC110 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = C.CMMNS_CD_ID AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AND D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{unitCode} ),0)) = 0 THEN '[미지원]' ELSE '' END ) || CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4, ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5, LACA_ADDTNG_MNG_CN, SRTNG_SQNCE, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM SAC100 C /* 공통코드 값 */
WHERE C.CMMNS_CD_ID = #{codeId} order by SRTNG_SQNCE asc

/* selectCommonCodeTotalList - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT C.CMMNS_CD_ID, C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE, C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4, C.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5, C.LACA_ADDTNG_MNG_CN, D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_SYS_SE_CD
FROM SAC100 C, SAC200 D
WHERE C.CMMNS_CD_ID = D.CMMNS_CD_ID AND D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{systemId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY C.CMMNS_CD_ID, C.SRTNG_SQNCE

/* selectOrgUnitSystem - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
C.INST_NO AS INST_CD, C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_SYS_SE_CD, D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS UNIT_SYSTEM_NAME
FROM SAA030 C /* 관리업무 시스템 */ , SAC100 D /* 공통코드 값 */
WHERE C.INST_NO = #{INST_CD} AND D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_SYS_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD
ORDER BY C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD
